How Food Smells and Moving Crowds Shape Fly Courtship | Nature

Ecological and social cues orchestrate concerted courtship in Drosophila
First author: Brand, Philipp
Last author: Ruta, Vanessa
Journal: Nature
Published online: 2026-11-04
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11209-9

Experiments in Drosophila erecta reveal how food odour sustains male courtship while movement among nearby flies further amplifies it, creating a feedback loop between individuals and their social surroundings. Comparisons with related species suggest that different weighting of shared sensory pathways can connect reproductive behaviour to a species’ ecological setting.
